name: template_train
description: Run the ML template on the headset, with no internet: it makes 3,000 examples from the truck's own sensors, trains a small network to tell when there's an obstacle ahead (about a second), saves it, and logs the run in the lab notebook. It answers when training is done. Say how it did in one line, comparing its held-out accuracy with the simple front-sensor rule's, then offer to put it on the truck as its brake with learned_brake. Use it when the person asks to train the ML template, the obstacle model or a learned brake.

name: template_status
description: The ML template's state: idle, training (with the epoch), done (with its accuracy and the rule it was compared with) or failed, and whether the learned brake is on the truck right now.

thing.description: Which Thing to report the brake for (default truck).

name: learned_brake
description: Put the ML template's trained network on a Thing as its brake (on), or give the Thing back the controller it had before (off). With it on, the truck cruises and brakes when the network thinks there's an obstacle ahead. Train it first with template_train. It changes only how the Thing drives and can be undone, so no confirmation is needed.
